scope: Census of every currently registered Plane, Place/region, Faction, Object/artifact and Character node. Not a census of all MTG canon or a declaration that every named entity has a complete history.
source_grade_rule: Only nonstructural claim edges carrying a registered, direct, official Wizards URL count. Origin files, card-name bridges, uncited neighbors and Scryfall card metadata are not direct lore proof.

limits: Graph registration is a curated inventory, not the universe of all MTG planes, regions, factions, objects or people.
One direct claim is not a complete biography, regional survey, faction membership or object history.
An officially cited disputed, implied or alternate-continuity claim is not automatically CANON_CONFIRMED.
Graph degree ranks only local research connectivity, never canonical historical importance.
This audit inventories evidence and gaps; it does not create unsupported lore edges or resolve contradictions.
